evals.prompt: Use the project-setup skill. I just configured a new Plane project with your setup workflow and want to be sure nothing is missing before the first sprint. What do you check, with which calls, and what result do you expect from each? In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: The four verification calls of the setup checklist with the expected result of each.
expectations: The answer checks the states with state(action=list, project_id=<id>)
The answer expects 4-6 states in the correct groups
The answer checks the labels with label(action=list, project_id=<id>)
The answer checks the types with workitem_type(action=list, project_id=<id>)
The answer expects at least the types Story, Task and Bug
The answer checks the features with project(action=get_features, project_id=<id>)

evals.prompt: Use the project-setup skill. Set up a brand new Plane project 'Mobile App' for a 3-person team. We want the minimal Agile setup, nothing fancy. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Applies the Lean Template: 4 states, minimal labels, Story + Bug types, cycles + pages features only.
expectations: The answer uses the Lean Template (not Standard)
The answer says to create exactly 4 states: Backlog → Todo → In Progress → Done
The answer says to create minimal labels: bug, feature, tech-debt, ready, blocked
The answer says to enable only cycles and pages features with project(action=update_features, cycles=true, pages=true)
The answer does NOT create Task or Spike types

evals.prompt: Use the project-setup skill. We have 6 developers and want the full Agile setup with modules, epics, and custom properties for WSJF scoring. List the states, work item types, features and custom properties you create, each with its call. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Applies the Standard Template: 6 states, all label groups, Story/Task/Bug/Spike types, cycles + modules + epics + pages + views, Business Value and Risk Level properties.
expectations: The answer uses the Standard Template
The answer creates the six states Backlog, Todo, In Progress, In Review, Done and Cancelled
The answer creates the types Story, Task, Bug and Spike with workitem_type(action=resolve)
The answer enables modules, epics and views with project(action=update_features)
The answer creates Business Value as a DECIMAL property with workitem_property(action=create, workitem_type_id, ...)
The answer creates Risk Level as an OPTION property with workitem_property(action=create, workitem_type_id, ...)

evals.prompt: Use the project-setup skill. Our project has 'WIP', 'Review', 'Merged' states but burndown looks wrong. What's the issue? Explain the cause, name the call that inspects it, give the fix call for the state that is wrong, and say what similar mistakes to check. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that state groups are likely misconfigured — 'Merged' (done) may be in 'started' group, breaking velocity counting.
expectations: The answer identifies the root cause: velocity counts only items moved to 'completed' group states
The answer suggests running state(action=list) to inspect group membership
The answer recommends reassigning 'Merged' to the 'completed' group via state(action=update, state_id, group='completed')
The answer warns about similar pitfalls (e.g., Done in 'started' group)
